name: UIBC
type: open repository set (draft specification + conformance vectors + reference verifier + pre-release bench)
description: A portable package that binds an agent's identity, lifecycle and action evidence into one hash-committed structure, plus a verification procedure with three-valued outcomes (PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE).
question_it_answers: Can a machine check what an agent left behind, from bytes alone — and say so when it cannot?
question_it_does_not_answer: Whether the agent behaved correctly, safely, or whether the recorded inputs were true.

verify.run: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/UIBC/vectors.git && cd vectors && python tools/run_vectors.py
verify.expected: MATRIX GATE OK - all 6 rows match.

citation_rules: A PASS without a pinned public key means internal consistency only, not authorship.
OK within the observed evidence boundary means no violation was detected; it is not a statement that the agent was correct or safe.
Machine reviewers must be labelled 'machine reviewer'; two implementations by the same author do not constitute an independent implementation.
